serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Skillsoft's Percipio is a SaaS learning experience platform that authenticates users, tracks learner's progress, and connects users to content and other optional services. Percipio offers 1000s of video-based courses along with ebooks, audiobooks, practice labs, boot camps, and assessments to help your workforce build skills. Percipio is accessible from both a web browser as well as Apple and Andriod mobile apps. The learning platform and mobile apps were assessed as in-boundary for FedRAMP. The external content providers are not assessed.
